deadline.value: No central deadline: apply to an advertised vacancy (each has its own deadline) or send an open application.
deadline.quote: There are several ways to obtain a PhD position. You can apply for a vacancy or submit an open application.

supervisor.value: An authorised supervisor must agree to accept you; a second supervisor is always appointed.
supervisor.quote: You can only pursue a PhD at the UvA once an authorised supervisor has agreed to accept you as a PhD candidate.

funding.value: Vacancy positions are salaried UvA employment; an open application may come without UvA funding.
funding.quote: If you are selected, you will be employed by the UvA and receive a salary. | In other cases, you may not receive funding from the UvA.

entry_route.value: A recognised Dutch master's degree or a comparable foreign qualification is required.
entry_route.quote: You meet the degree requirement if you hold a recognised and accredited Dutch Master’s degree or a comparable foreign qualification.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: UvA-wide rules; the institute's own vacancy pages state no further admission rules.
